fusions.name: Lanced and Drawn
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up. The venom is drawn back out as a bolt that deals 8 poison damage and heals you for 30% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Spoiled Remedy
fusions.desc: Breathes a bitter mist 5 tiles ahead of you that deals 26 poison damage to everything in it and ignores resistances. Each target is left [Diseased] for 10 seconds, so healing does less for it.

fusions.name: Milked for Serum
fusions.desc: Removes up to 3 poison conditions from you and restores 12 health to you.

fusions.name: Hardened by Trace Amounts
fusions.desc: Each time you inflict a condition, you regain 2 health a second for 3 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.
